"""Cycle member B: the other half of the deliberate import-time cycle.

Also closes a second, deferred lap over the same module pair: the
function-level import is a distinct edge (different line, deferred
binding), so the same two modules carry both an import-time cycle and a
deferred back-edge.
"""

from pkg.cycle_a import alpha_step

BETA_BASE = 3


def beta_step(value: int) -> int:
    return alpha_step(value) - 1


def beta_deferred(value: int) -> int:
    from pkg.cycle_a import alpha_step as deferred_alpha

    return deferred_alpha(value) + 1
